item.title: Zack Snyder Says He Treated DC's Characters With "Reverence And Respect" While Sharing New Superman Photo
item.description: Man of Steel, Batman v Superman, and Justice League director Zack Snyder has shared another never-before-seen shot of Henry Cavill's Superman and reflects on his time in the DC Extended Universe...

item.title: SUPERMAN Star David Corenswet Reflects On Heated On-Set Debate With James Gunn: "[He Was] Indefatigable"
item.description: In a new interview, Superman star David Corenswet recalls his intense on-set debate with director James Gunn about how a certain scene from the final act should be played...

item.title: Miles Morales Co-Creator Reveals She Hasn’t Received Any Money For The Character’s Billion-Dollar Franchise
item.description: Sara Pichelli, co-creator of Miles Morales, revealed during an interview that she does not get royalties for any of the character’s films or games, calling it “the saddest part” of her life.

item.title: "OI! OI!" SPIDER-PUNK Spin-Off Gets Major Update From Daniel Kaluuya
item.description: A Spider-Punk spin-off is on the way! Daniel Kaluuya revealed that he’s in the “finishing stages” of writing the script for the much-anticipated Spider-Verse spin-off film.

item.title: SUPERGIRL Official Trailer Teaser Reveals The Maiden Of Might Like You've Never Seen Her Before!
item.description: DC Studios has just dropped a teaser for Supergirl, and it features an exciting new take on the Woman of Tomorrow (played by House of the Dragon star Milly Alcock). The full trailer is also on the way...

item.title: FIVE NIGHTS AT FREDDY's 2 Claims The Domestic Box Office Crown But ZOOTOPIA 2 Is The Real Monster
item.description: Zootopia 2 continues its stampede at the global box office, despite the fact that Five Nights At Freddy's 2 debuted in first place in North America.

item.title: SUPERMAN Star David Corenswet Reveals The One Note From James Gunn He Refused To Budge On: "I Was Like, 'No!'"
item.description: David Corenswet has revealed that Superman director James Gunn told him a certain scene wasn't quite working, but the actor refused to budge, and it ended up in the movie...

item.title: Resurfaced BTS Images From THE AVENGERS Show Much Better Design For Captain America’s Most Controversial Suit
item.description: Resurfaced photos show a much better designed for Captain America’s costume from The Avengers, often considered his most controversial suit in the MCU.

item.title: IT: WELCOME TO DERRY Episode 7 Recap: Pennywise's Twisted Past Is Revealed As The Death Toll Rises - SPOILERS
item.description: Tonight's episode of It: Welcome to Derry was full of twists, turns, and some character deaths. Along the way, more of Pennywise the Clown's twisted origin story was finally revealed ahead of the finale.
